about_the_game:
Escape to a cozy pixel world where you can farm, fish, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Grow crops, chop wood, mine for resources, and trade with villagers — each with their own stories to share. Whether you’re tending the soil, casting your line off the dock, drawing / discovering art from other players, or uncovering hidden treasures, every day brings something new. 

Build your farm, meet unique NPCs, and shape your own adventure at a relaxing pace.

  • Grow and harvest crops

  • Relax with fishing, mining, woodcutting

  • Draw art to send out to other players, and receive from random players

  • Interact with NPCs to learn the story of the island

  • Work hard to upgrade and maybe leave the island

  • Windows/Mac/Steamdeck Compatible

short_description: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet quirky NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.
